caption: Global Metadata: dream pop, 92 BPM, A minor, wistful turning hopeful, late-night drive, warm analog production with tape saturation. Vocal Details: female lead, airy breathy timbre, intimate delivery, stacked harmonies in the chorus, generous plate reverb. Arrangement: shimmering electric guitar and analog pad, soft brushed drums, round sub bass, chorus opens up with a wide guitar double. Intro is guitar and pad alone, drums enter with the first verse, the pre-chorus tightens onto the hi-hat, the chorus opens wide with octave guitars, the bridge drops to pad and voice, the final chorus adds a high harmony, and the outro decays into tape hiss.
lyrics: [intro]
[verse]
Headlights paint the empty road
Radio hums a song I almost know
Mile markers blur like passing years
Windows down to dry the quiet tears
[pre-chorus]
Count the exits, count them slow
Anywhere is where we go
[chorus]
Hold the night a little longer
Every mile makes the morning stronger
Stay with me till the streetlights fade
We'll drive right through the dark we made
[verse]
Coffee going cold in the cup holder
Your jacket folded over my shoulder
Signs for towns we'll never see
And that is exactly where I want to be
[pre-chorus]
Count the exits, count them slow
Anywhere is where we go
[chorus]
Hold the night a little longer
Every mile makes the morning stronger
Stay with me till the streetlights fade
We'll drive right through the dark we made
[bridge]
If the sun comes up too soon
We will turn around and chase the moon
[chorus]
Hold the night a little longer
Every mile makes the morning stronger
Stay with me till the streetlights fade
We'll drive right through the dark we made
[outro]
Hold the night a little longer
Hold the night a little longer
